meta.title: Matrix Calculator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Add, multiply, transpose matrices of any size. Enter matrices row by row.
matrixHint: Separate rows by newlines, columns by spaces or commas.
steps_matrix-calculator_1Desc: Input your matrices by typing values or using the grid editor. Supported sizes from 1×1 to 10×10. Define both matrices if the operation uses two.
steps_matrix-calculator_2Desc: Choose add, subtract, multiply, transpose, determinant, or inverse. The result matrix displays instantly with all computed values.
steps_matrix-calculator_3Desc: Copy individual values or the entire result matrix. Essential for linear algebra coursework, 3D graphics programming, and engineering calculations.
desc: Add, multiply, transpose matrices of any size. Enter matrices row by row.
singular: The matrix is not invertible (determinant is 0)
dimMismatch: Addition/subtraction requires both matrices to have the same dimensions: A is
mulMismatch: Multiplication requires A's columns to equal B's rows: A is
needSquare: This operation requires a square matrix: currently
